prompt:
Pixel-art character turnaround sheet for a monster in a Doom/Hexen-style first-person dark-fantasy dungeon game, where monsters are drawn as sprites seen from several camera angles: the KNIGHT, a slow, heavily armoured undead-looking warrior behind a huge tower shield. Spells splash off the shield, so the player must get behind it or close in with a sword.

REFERENCE IMAGES, in the order attached: turnaround sheets of two other monsters from the same game (a red imp, and a robed acolyte). Use them ONLY for the art style and the sheet layout: pixel size, outline weight, shading, how the views are arranged and how far each one is turned. Do not copy anything of their designs.

THE KNIGHT
- A broad, heavy human figure in full plate armour, about a third taller than the imp would be beside it and a little taller than the acolyte, standing squarely with its feet apart, braced and still.
- Dark, battered iron plate with dull highlights and patches of rust, dented and scratched. A great helm with a narrow eye slit; inside the slit, only black shadow and two tiny cold pale-blue glints.
- A torn, faded tabard of dark green cloth over the breastplate, hanging below the waist, ragged at the hem.
- A heavy grey chainmail skirt below the tabard, armoured greaves and sabatons.
- A TOWER SHIELD on its LEFT arm: a tall rectangle with a gently curved face, as tall as the knight from its feet to the top of its helm, and as wide as its shoulders. Dark oak planks, banded with riveted iron straps, an iron rim, a round iron boss in the middle, and a faded, chipped painted emblem (a pale cross) on the planks. The bottom edge of the shield rests on the ground.
- In its RIGHT hand, a heavy flanged iron mace, held down at its side, its head hanging near the knee.
- A muted, grimy palette: dark iron, rust brown, faded moss green, dark oak, chainmail grey, and pale blue only for the eye glints.

THE SHIELD IN EACH VIEW (this matters for the game: the shield covers the knight from the front)
- FRONT: the shield faces the viewer squarely and hides almost the whole body. Only the top of the helm with its eye slit shows above it, a little of the armoured right shoulder, the mace arm and the mace at the image-left edge of the shield, and the sabatons below it. The shield is held on the knight's left arm, so it is on the image-right side of the body's centre, but wide enough to cover the body.
- FRONT THREE-QUARTER: the shield, seen at an angle, still covers the knight's front; the helm, the right shoulder and the mace arm show beside it.
- SIDE (profile): the shield is seen edge-on, as a tall, thick slab held in front of the body on the arm nearer the viewer; the body behind it, the helm, the tabard and the mace show clearly.
- REAR THREE-QUARTER and BACK: the knight's back is open: the back plates, the tabard's back panel, the helm's back. Only the shield's rim and the inside of its straps show at the side.

LAYOUT
- One horizontal row of 5 equal cells, read left to right: FRONT (facing the viewer), FRONT THREE-QUARTER, SIDE (profile), REAR THREE-QUARTER, BACK (facing away).
- In the front three-quarter, side and rear three-quarter views the knight faces IMAGE-LEFT.
- The shield stays on the same arm (the left) and the mace in the same hand (the right) in every view, so each is on the opposite side of the body in the front and back views.
- The same figure at the same scale in every cell, standing on the same ground line, in the same pose; only the camera angle changes.
- Background: flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, with no gradient, texture, vignette, glow, cast shadow or floor.
- The cells are separated by thin vertical lines of pure cyan (#00FFFF), each running the full height of the image.
- The whole figure, including the shield's top and the mace, fits inside each cell with a clear magenta margin. Nothing touches a cell edge or a cyan line, and nothing is cropped.
- No text, labels, numbers, frame borders, sparks, smoke or effects outside the figure.
- Crisp pixel art with hard edges and no anti-aliasing against the magenta. No semi-transparent pixels, and no pink or purple glow bleeding into the background.
